code-delivery: Select full-send intentionally; code validation then seven-role review-panel outside graph.
Use writing-loop for PR title/body; authorize only scoped task Git/PR actions and conditional merge.
Do not authorize comments, thread resolution, or unrelated work.
prose-handoff: Select full-stop and writing-loop with Unslop/Reducer/fresh Editor.
Leave accepted text for user action; no PR or Git requirement and no external send/publication.
mixed-stop: Select code review-panel and prose writing-loop.
Inspect and disable both automatic merge mechanisms before task edits/pushes; verify state.
Never merge, queue, or default-branch push; final exact-version reviews and readiness gate required.
skill-question: Do not invoke full-send/full-stop or authorize repository mutations.
Answer information request; reading skill sources as data is permitted.
incidental-stop: Do not invoke full-stop or a panel merely from closing emphasis.
missing-prose-dependency: Block the dependent writing stage for missing Unslop; do not invent its rules or claim acceptance.
No Git/PR/external publication and no self-review substituted for independent acceptance.
stale-pr-evidence: Invalidate affected old proof/reviews; reconcile head C/base D and known human changes request.
Do not merge or claim ready; require current proof, reviews and known mergeability.
unknown-automatic-merge: Queue-state evidence gap blocks PR mutations and ready handoff.
Do not infer disabled automatic merging from a missing field or merge/queue.
graph-owner: Use graph's approved review/test route; preserve sole writer, budgets and PR Engineer mutations.
No unapproved extra seven-role panel or second generic-loop; do not claim graph equals full panel.
Conditional merge still needs live gate and applicable approved publication authority.
exhausted-and-unknown: No fourth code repair or budget reset.
No duplicate watcher until old execution reconciled; retain original deadline.
Report blocker and unresolved defect; no approval or merge.
standalone-watch: Read/report only; no implementation, pushes, comments, resolution or merge.
Green CI is insufficient; report approval/thread blockers, not readiness.
draft-only-pr: Use writing-loop for title/body and evidence from selected diff.
Return text only; do not commit, push, create/update PR or claim a published URL.
approved-current-head: Recognize that the required approval is satisfied, not a blocker merely because approval is required.
Allow only the authorized merge method after a final live gate bound to the reviewed head; verify actual merge/commit before claiming completion.
Do not post comments or resolve threads; cleanup follows active rules after verified merge.
